parties: Rashi Peripherals Limited acquires VDA Infosolutions Private Limited
headline: Rashi Peripherals acquires VDA Infosolutions; statutory auditors reappointed
sum: Rashi Peripherals' board approved acquisition of VDA Infosolutions Private Limited, marking the IT distributor's entry into software solutions; consideration and deal structure to be disclosed in formal announcement.
implication: Strategic bolt-on acquisition by a listed IT distributor signals shift toward higher-margin software/managed services, requiring review of competition law (CCI) clearance thresholds and earn-out structuring under ITA 1961.
detail: Rashi Peripherals Limited, a tier-1 IT hardware and peripheral distributor listed on NSE and BSE, approved the acquisition of VDA Infosolutions Private Limited by board resolution on 23 Jun 2026. VDA Infosolutions is a software solutions and IT services firm. The acquisition was approved alongside the reappointment of statutory auditors for a second tenure. No consideration amount was disclosed in the board announcement; formal disclosure and valuation details are pending in the stock exchange filing.

framework.note: Disclosure of material acquisition to stock exchange within 30 minutes of approval; classification as 'material' if value exceeds 5% of market cap.
